description_en: Remaining nonexistent for an unknown period of time, Deypukhūsi Kuṃ Phalcā was restored prior to the 2015 earthquakes, reviving the stone plinth that had endured through the years.Deypukhū, which translates to "pond of a country/city," serves as the central pond within the historic Newar settlement of Kirtipur, hosting various religious and cultural events around it. Its name derives fromdey, signifying a country or settlement, andpukhū, indicating a pond. Among the numerousphalcās built around the pond, this particular one occupies the southeastern corner.Even the elderly residents of the area had no recollection of a properphalcāat this location. Only the stone plinth had survived until 2013 CE, while thephalcāitself might have vanished at least a century earlier. Unfortunately, there is no inscription shedding light on the initial construction of thephalcā. Commencing in November 2013 and in collaboration with UN-Habitat, CIUD, and local communities, a project named "Revitalization of Open Spaces in Kirtipur" oversaw the restoration of Deypukhū, the erection of a boundary wall, and the reconstruction of thisphalcā. The reconstruction, which was finalized in March 2014, also included the installation of a statue of Lokeśvara within thephalcā(Andersson 2014, report, UIUD).At present (February 2023), no socio-cultural activities occur at this site, as anyguṭhīrelated to thephalcālikely ceased to be operational with the extinction of thephalcā.
description_ne: लामो समय अघि लोप भैसकोको र पेटीमात्र बचेको फल्चा विसं २०७२ सालको भूकम्पको ठीक अगाडी मात्रै पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको हो ।नेवार बस्तीभित्र बस्तीको केन्द्र भागमा अवस्थित र धार्मिक सांस्कृतिक गतिविधिहरू हुने गरेका पोखरीलाई देय्‌पुखू भनिन्छ । देय्‌को अर्थ 'देश' वा ‘बस्ती’ हो भने बस्तीको मूलपोखरीको रूपमा रहेको पोखरीलाई ‘देय्‌पुखू’ (देशपोखरी) भनिन्छ । कीर्तिपुरको मध्य भागमा पनि धार्मिक एवं सांस्कृतिक दृष्टिले महत्त्वपूर्ण देय्‌पुखू अवस्थित छ । अवस्थिति र सांस्कृतिक गतिविधिका दृष्टिले महत्त्वपूर्ण यस पोखरीको चौतर्फी फल्चाहरू बनेका छन् । तीमध्ये यो दक्षिणपूर्वी कुनामा अवस्थित फल्चा हो ।सन् २०१३ सम्म यो फल्चाको अस्तित्वको रूपमा ढुङ्गाको पेटीमात्र बचेको अवस्था थियो । अस्सी वर्ष पुगेका वृद्धहरूलाई पनि पेटी बाहेक यहाँ फल्चा उभिएको स्मरण नभएकाले करिब एक शताव्दीअघि नै फल्चा भत्किसकेको हुनसक्दछ । पेटीमात्र बचेको स्थानमा अभिलेख नपाइएकाले यसको प्रारम्भिक निर्माण कसले र कहिले गर्‍यो भन्ने तथ्य पनि अज्ञात बन्न पुगेको छ । सन् २०१३ नोभेम्बरदेखि UN-Habitat, CIUD र स्थानीयको सहकार्यमा “Revitalisation of Open Spaces in Kirtipur” शीर्षकमा देय्‌पुखूको मर्मतकार्य, किनारामा पर्खाल निर्माणका साथै यस फल्चाको पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको थियो । पुनर्निर्माणका क्रममा फल्चामा लोकेश्वरको मूर्ति पनि हालिएको थियो । सन् २०१४ को मार्चतिर निर्माणकार्यले सम्पन्नता पाएको थियो (Andersson 2014, report, UIUD) ।करिब एक शताव्दीअघि नै लोप भई विस्मरणमा पुगेको फल्चासंग सम्बन्धित गुठी पनि लोप भैसकेको देखिन्छ ।

historical_events.event_description: A newphalcāwas built here on a stone plinth that had survived from its previous construction. Commencing in November 2013 and in collaboration with UN-Habitat, CIUD, and local communities, a project named "Revitalization of Open Spaces in Kirtipur" oversaw the reconstruction of thisphalcāalong with the restoration of Deypukhū, and the erection of a boundary wall. The reconstruction, which was finalized in March 2014, also included the installation of a statue of Lokeśvara within thephalcā. As even the elderly residents of the area had no recollection of a properphalcāat this location, its former structure is unknown. There is no inscription shedding light on the initial construction of thephalcā.
